- **CBSE:** after the **OSM controversy** (Class XII, 2026; OSM expanded as "Online Scoring System"), Chairman **Rahul Singh** and Secretary **Himanshu Gupta** were removed on **2 June 2026**; **Prashant Sitaram Lokhande** (Chairman) and **Varun Bhardwaj** (Secretary) took over in June 2026.

- [04 Nov 2026] **Dr. Ashok Kumar Mahapatra**, neurosurgeon, died in New Delhi aged **74**; born **29 December 1952 in Puri, Odisha**; **founding Director of AIIMS Bhubaneswar** and head of Neurosurgery, AIIMS New Delhi; led the team that separated the **conjoined twins Jaga and Balia (AIIMS, 2017)**; **Padma Shri 2025** for neurosurgery; Padma Awards instituted **1954**, administered by the **Home Ministry**.
- **Elected 18 June 2026** at the **36th Meeting of States Parties to UNCLOS, UN HQ New York** (**7 judges** elected) – **115 of 168** valid votes.
- **ITLOS:** under UNCLOS; est. **1996**; HQ **Hamburg, Germany**; **21 judges**, 9-year term.
- **Vivek Agarwal** = **FATF** (Paris).
- **SEBI** – statutory **1992**.

- **Bangladesh:** the **BNP** won the **12 February 2026** parliamentary election by a landslide (two-thirds) – **BNP 209 of 297** seats, **Jamaat-e-Islami 68**; **Tarique Rahman** sworn in as **Prime Minister** on **17 February 2026** by President **Mohammed Shahabuddin**.
# Governor changes – March 2026 (9 States/UTs; list of 6 March 2026)

- Other heads (2026): Cabinet Secretary **T.V. Somanathan** (33rd; one-year extension beyond 30 Aug 2026); CJI **Surya Kant** (**53rd**, Nov 2025); CEC **Gyanesh Kumar** (**26th**, 19 Feb 2025); NCW **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar** (9th); ISRO **V. Narayanan**; GSI DG **Dinesh Vithalrao Ganvir** (**55th**, Nov 2026; succeeded **Varsha Ashok Aglawe** – first woman, 54th); Education Minister **Pralhad Joshi** (26 July 2026, replaced Dharmendra Pradhan).

- Passage: **Union Cabinet** decided on the amendment (May 2026, the **150th year** of Vande Mataram; the Act is implemented by the **MHA**); introduced **Rajya Sabha 24 July 2026**; passed RS **29 July**, LS **30 July**; **assent 6 August 2026** (Act No. 11 of 2026, Gazette of India Extraordinary; Rocket CA prints 11 Aug, the date it was reported).

- **Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Ordinance, 2026** (Cabinet approval **5 May 2026**; promulgated **16 May 2026** under **Article 123**): **puisne judges 33 → 37**; total **34 → 38 including the CJI**.

- **Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026** replaced the ordinance; passed by **Lok Sabha on 3 Aug 2026**; passed as a **Money Bill** - the Rajya Sabha only returned it (Aug 2026); **assent 11 August 2026** (**Act No. 14 of 2026**); amends the **Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1956**.
# Supreme Court Collegium (May 2026)
- Background: Article 124 (SC), Article 50 (separation of judiciary), Article 235; SC inaugurated **28 January 1950**; strength **38** including the CJI (since 2026).
- **Kerala (Alteration of Name) Act, 2026**: Kerala → **"Keralam"**; amends the **First Schedule**; under **Article 3** – an ordinary law, **not an Article 368 amendment**.

- Union Cabinet approval **24 Feb 2026**; Kerala Assembly endorsed **1 June 2026** (Article 3 reference); passed **Lok Sabha first (11 Aug)**, then **Rajya Sabha (12 Aug 2026)**; assent Aug 2026; in force **25 August 2026** (MHA notification); **HC name unchanged**.
- **Union Cabinet (24 Feb 2026)** approved **free HPV vaccination for girls of 14** (the same meeting cleared Kerala → "Keralam").

- Notified **27 August 2026** under the **Legal Metrology Act 2009** (**Ministry of Consumer Affairs**); make IST the **single legal time reference** for legal, administrative, commercial and official purposes.

- Organisations must only sync with **IST-traceable** time - no need for every organisation to own an atomic clock; critical sectors (telecom, banking, energy, transport, data centres) must sync with authorised Indian time sources - e.g. **NavIC**.
- Display in **hh:mm:ss** (not hh:mm) mandatory at railway stations, airports, government offices; other time zones may be displayed **only along with IST**.

- IST = **UTC+5:30**, maintained by **CSIR-National Physical Laboratory** (India's National Metrology Institute); Standard Meridian **82°30′ E**, near **Mirzapur, UP** – India has a **single time zone**; **IST® trademark** registered in **2024**; uncertainty **< 3 nanoseconds** vs UTC.

- **cVIGIL (ECI app):** citizens report **Model Code of Conduct violations** with live, **geo-tagged** photos or videos; the ECI aims to act on a complaint **within 100 minutes** (not a permissions app for candidates).

- **Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India** (**27 May 2026**; Bench led by **CJI Surya Kant**): SC **upheld** the ECI order (**24 June 2025**) for **Special Intensive Revision (SIR)** of rolls - begun in **Bihar** before the **November 2025 Bihar Assembly elections**; a power from **Article 324** and the **RP Act, 1950**; **broadly proportionate**; ECI best placed to decide the method.
- **North Eastern Council** is under a separate **NEC Act 1971** (not the States Reorganisation Act 1956).

- Outlay **₹3,788.04 crore** (Centre **₹2,353.15 crore**, States/UTs **₹1,434.89 crore**) – revised from **₹1,952.23 crore** for 2023–26; Central share from the **Nirbhaya Fund** (**2013**, **non-lapsable**, Ministry of Finance).

| Phase | Period | Focus |
|---|---|---|
| I | 2011-2015 | Computerising 14,000+ courts |
| II | 2015-2023 | NJDG, e-Filing, e-payment, e-Sewa Kendras, video conferencing, virtual courts |
| III | 2023-2027 | Paperless courts, virtual hearings, AI, OCR - outlay ₹7,210 crore |
- **Phase III** (Cabinet **13 Sep 2023**; **Central Sector Scheme**; targets **1,150 virtual courts** and **4,400 eSewa Kendras**) - progress:

| Step | Event |
|---|---|
| 8 April 2025 | SC (Justices **J.B. Pardiwala, R. Mahadevan**), **Tamil Nadu** Governor case: set timelines – **first judicially enforceable timelines on Governors and the President** |
| May 2025 | Presidential Reference under **Art 143(1)** on **Articles 200 and 201** |
| 20 Nov 2025 | Five-judge Constitution Bench (**CJI B.R. Gavai**): **no court-imposed timelines** for the Governor (Art 200) or President (Art 201), **deemed assent rejected**; **limited mandamus** possible for prolonged, unexplained inaction |
- **143(1):** opinion is **advisory, not binding** – not "law declared" under **Article 141**; **143(2):** disputes over **pre-Constitution treaties and agreements**.
- **e-Zero FIR** (MHA/I4C, May 2025) was first piloted in **Delhi**.
- **[9 Nov 2026] NPPA** capped trade margins on the MRP of **137 anti-cancer drugs** (follow-up of the Oct 2026 **30% trade-margin cap**); **Pharma Sahi Daam** app.
- **[10 Nov 2026] NMC** (National Medical Commission, **Ministry of Health**) warned students against **fake medical colleges**.

- UCC Bills of **Assam, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh** awaited Presidential assent (Sep 2026 debate). **Assam UCC Bill, 2026**: introduced **25 May**, passed **27 May 2026** – **third State** (after Uttarakhand, Gujarat) and **first in the North-East**; **bans polygamy**; live-in relationships registered **within one month**; **Scheduled Tribes exempted**.

- **17 April 2026**: **528 voted – 298 in favour, 230 against**; special majority needed **326** → **defeated in the Lok Sabha** (it never reached the Rajya Sabha); Delimitation Bill 2026 then withdrawn.

- **2021 Census** postponed due to **COVID-19**; Census 2027 comes after a **6-year delay**.
- **Digital tools by C-DAC** (HLBC, HL Mobile App, Self-Enumeration Portal, CMMS); **self-enumeration up to 15 days** before field work; all buildings **geotagged during Houselisting Operations** (not Population Enumeration).
- **Mascots "Pragati" and "Vikas"**; brand ambassador **Sudarsan Pattnaik**; RGI **Mrityunjay Kumar Narayan**.
- After the MHA declared Naxalism eliminated, districts are grouped as **"Legacy and Thrust" (37 districts)** and **"Districts of Concern"**.

- Reconsidered **Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa (1978)** - **7-judge** bench, majority by **Justice V.R. Krishna Iyer**, **"Triple Test"** (systematic activity; employer-employee cooperation; goods/services for human wants – **profit motive and capital irrelevant**); **Dominant Nature Test** – the **primary function** decides; hearing from **17 March 2026**; the reference arose via **State of UP v. Jai Bir Singh (2005)**; the **Industrial Disputes (Amendment) Act, 1982** was **never notified**.

- **Held:** SC allowed **withdrawal of life support** (life-sustaining treatment) for Harish Rana (**13 years** in a vegetative state; judgment reserved **January 2026**) – right to die with dignity is part of **Art 21**.

| Case | Holding |
|---|---|
| Maruti Dubal (Bombay HC, 1987) | A High Court first recognised a right to die |
| P. Rathinam (1994) | Recognised a right to die – **overruled by Gian Kaur** |
| **Gian Kaur v. Punjab (1996)** | Right to live with dignity; rejected a right to die |
| **Aruna Shanbaug (2011)** | **Passive euthanasia** in exceptional cases |
| **Common Cause (2018)** | Right to die with dignity; refuse treatment; **living wills** (guidelines simplified **2023**: primary and secondary boards; doctors' experience **20 → 5 years**) |
| **Chenna Jagadeeswar v. State of A.P.** (AP HC) | Right to life does **not** include the right to die |
- **BNS 2023:** Sec 100 culpable homicide, **Sec 101 murder**, Sec 108 abetment of suicide.
- **Temple:** in **Periyar Tiger Reserve**, Kerala; deity Ayyappa – a **Naishtika Brahmachari**, the basis for barring women aged **10–50**; **41-day penance**; run by **Travancore Devaswom Board**.

- **Doctrine:** **Shirur Mutt (1954)** – essential religious practices (also **Sastri Yagnapurushadji**); **Anti-Exclusion Test** – **Justice D.Y. Chandrachud** (2018); **Art 145(3)** – at least **five judges** for a substantial question of constitutional interpretation; **Art 25** individual freedom of religion; Art 26 denominational rights (subject to public order, morality, health).
- Opposition notice against Lok Sabha Speaker **Om Birla** (**10 February 2026**, Budget Session) – submitted by Congress Chief Whip **K. Suresh** for Congress, SP, DMK.

| Step | Rule |
|---|---|
| Notice | At least **14 days'** written notice to the **Secretary-General** |
| Leave | At least 50 members |
| Passing | **Majority of all the then members** – **Art 94(c)** |
| While pending | Speaker **cannot preside**, but may **speak and vote in the first instance**; no casting vote (Art 96) |

| Article (LS / State) | Subject |
|---|---|
| 93 / 178 | Election of Speaker, Deputy Speaker |
| 94 / **179** | Vacation, resignation, **removal** |
| **95** / 180 | **Deputy Speaker acts as Speaker** |
| 96 / 181 | Not to preside while removal is pending |
| 100 / 189 | Casting vote in a tie |
| 110(4) / 199(4) | Speaker **certifies Money Bills** |

- **PROG Act, 2025** (Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming; **assent 22 August 2025**): **bans online money (real-money) games**; promotes e-sports and **online social games** (casual/educational, no betting); sets up an **Online Gaming Authority**; offering money games up to **3 years + ₹1 crore**, advertising up to 2 years + ₹50 lakh; offences **cognisable and non-bailable**; **players are not penalised**.

- **GST 40%** on lottery, betting, casinos, online money gaming from **22 September 2025** (online gaming revised from **28%** on entry fee/deposit, 2023); winnings taxed **30% (Sec 115BB)**, TDS **Sec 194B**.

- **AP case:** SC/ST (PoA) complaint by **Pastor Chintada Anand Paul** (Guntur); AP HC (**Justice N. Harinath**) held SC status **ceases immediately on conversion to Christianity** and quashed the charges (30 April 2025); SC Bench **Prashant Kumar Mishra and Manmohan** dismissed the SLP.
- **Returning Officer:** **P.C. Mody** (RS Secretary General).

- **Leh Apex Body** and **Kargil Democratic Alliance** (Sonam Wangchuk; protests **September 2025**) - four demands: **statehood**, the **Sixth Schedule**, job/education reservation, representation; Ladakh UT since **31 October 2019**.
